item.title: Palantir Foundry Transition & Exit Contract
item.description:
NHS England has put in place a new 12 month contract for the transition from the Palantir Foundry platform to the new Federated Data Platform & Associate Services (FDP-AS) supplier. This is to provide the smooth transition and exit service of critical products that were developed to respond to the Covid-19 pandemic (for Covid-19 and elective recovery purposes), to alternative provisions including the transition of products to the new FDP-AS supplier following completion of the procurement process and award to the FDP-AS supplier.  This 12 month transition contract with Palantir will support the safe transition and exit from the incumbent supplier to the new FDP-AS supplier when it is awarded and established. 

This contract notice references the future Federated Data Platform & Associated Services (FDP-AS) contract for context,  however it should be noted it is a separate contract and procurement process.

item.title: Unified Data Platform Phase 1
item.description:
The MPS has purchased licencing and services to trial Palantir Foundry software to integrate diverse structured and unstructured datasets into a unified environment.  
The objectives are: 
 - to bring together internal data we already hold from multiple standalone systems into a form which can be used without delay as part of our professional standards work; 
 - to integrate back office datasets to provide enterprise reporting as part of its professional services function; and
 - to test if the tool can help us identify patterns, automate some analysis and reporting and support officer-led decisions.

item.title: Project Marconi
item.description:
Call-Off Contract description:	MP&T Operations Cell lacked a unified, accurate and reliable IT system, to provide timely and accurate training progress and deployment records". The solution is to take the form of a Proof-of-Concept application, building on the previously successful two-week sprint trial, conducted with Palantir through Pj KRAKEN to deliver the outcomes below.

The overall outcome of the proof of concept is to support the user through the delivery of a decision-making support application. This will include the following capabilities demonstrated operationally via a single, integrated platform:

•	A user centric solution which enables the creation of an integrated data capability that serves as a single source of truth.
•	A solution comprising of a comprehensive collection of applications, processes and tools that allow users to conduct the collection, analysis, investigation, and  reporting/visualisation/ exploitation of data workflows at scale and produce actionable intelligence from their full range. Specifically front-end dashboards to be rolled out for use by MOD personnel in a self-service fashion.
•	A solution that allows the user to view the total DMS medical workforce, and how this breaks down under the command of DMS Gp and the sS including workforce economics, personal data fields such as total numbers, rank, relevant health data (eg JMES, FHP details), unit employed, establishment lines, career employment group (CEG), JPA competencies. 
•	A solution that allows the user to understand the Force Generation (FGen) status of personnel against required single service and Joint standards for clinical, military and Force Health Protection (FHP) competencies/requirements.
•	A solution that allows use of historic and predicted DMS workforce demand to inform workforce planning and placement negotiations.

item.title: Defence Medical Services (DMS) - Placements Consultants Monitoring Application
item.description:
The development of a Placements Consultants monitoring application to support the input of the hours worked and job plans for DMS Clinical consultants.

This would take the form of an integrated IT system including a user interface to input the required data and also database to store.

The tool will also provide high fidelity data for Defence Consultant Advisors (DCAs) to undertake annual job plan reviews of their cadres, ensuring the individuals remain clinically current to deploy and have the time in-built to deliver appropriate outputs for Defence.

The overall outcome is to support the user through the delivery of a user interface application and database that can input/ interpret the data, and populate a data base, and also allow its exploitation through MARCONI software. 

The secondary output of this product is to create a supporting database which is structured and compiled on appropriate technical architecture, within MOD environments that enables data analysis and exploitation via either PowerBi via MODNet or Palantir Foundry software.

Framework Call-Off Lot 3 (Cloud Support) of the G-Cloud 13 Framework Agreement (RM1557.13)

item.title: Contract Extension of the Data Platform Services
item.description:
This contract is to extend the Data Platform Service for the provision of the Foundry platform until 11th June 2023 to support the procurement of the new NHS Federated Data Platform.

The NHS Federated Data platform procurement project is a large and complex project which will deliver a replacement for the current service. 

There are a number of reasons why a new procurement process has not been possible until now. NHS England is committed to procuring the future provision and requires adequate time to do so. The new NHS Federated Data Platform is a large and complex project which we expect will deliver a transformed service when compared to the current service. A change of contractor at this stage would cause significant inconvenience and have substantial duplication of cost implications as in order to compliantly replace the contractor now would require two concurrent procurement processes to be run for the same service. It would therefore be both impractical and uneconomic. The total value of this modification does not exceed 50% of the original contract value.

This was procured through G-Cloud.
